title: When the Wheel Strategy ACTUALLY Beats SPY
text: When we have periods like 2011 and 2015 when the market was kind of doing nothing and going sideways, you'll notice that the wheel actually does well. It outperformed S&P both those years because of that premium you're collecting during periods when things are quiet. We also have the effect of collecting premium, which is a dampening effect, and we could take a look at the performance in '08 and '22, which was a bear market, and the wheel outperformed SPY in both of those.
